correction_candidates.source_issue: The independence item joins two complete sentences with a comma after 'independent'.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Use a sentence boundary; leave authority unchanged.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The alt text says 'There is only non-zero bin beyond 5', omitting 'one'.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Describe exactly one non-zero bin beyond 5 in localized alt text.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The worked answer begins 'Each samples is', a number-agreement error.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Use the singular meaning 'each sample'; leave authority unchanged.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The phrase 'use sample value' is missing the article 'a'.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Render the intended sample-value substitution naturally.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The alt text says 'the is a sizable fraction' and describes the plotted df=2 t density as more sharply peaked than the normal density; at zero the plotted t density is lower/flatter, while its tails are heavier.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Correct the grammar and describe the visible center/tail relationship without reversing the peak-height ordering.

correction_candidates.source_issue: Several clauses treat plural 'degrees of freedom' as singular ('describes', 'is about 30').
correction_candidates.translation_action: Use grammatical number while preserving df=n-1 and all values.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The alt text has a malformed possessive ('distributions tails') and says the peak becomes less sharp as df grows; the plotted densities instead converge upward at zero toward the normal density while their tails thin.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Correct both grammar and the plotted peak/tail trend in localized alt text.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The section and caption specify df=18, but the producer uses df=10. A direct PDF text probe also exposes the stray placeholder word 'Text'.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Regenerate the localized figure with df=18 and no placeholder while preserving the -2.10 cutoff and tail geometry.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The source describes df=20 in the left panel and df=2 in the right panel, but the producer uses df=12 and df=2.3, respectively.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Regenerate the two panels with df=20 and df=2; preserve cutoffs and shading.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The worked prompt says 'this degrees of freedom' and the response says 'The degrees of freedom is easy to calculate'.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Render the intended number of degrees of freedom grammatically.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The guided question calls the displayed plot a histogram 'of the differences', but the active run17 asset is a histogram of sampled 10-mile run times.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Refer to the sampled run times, consistent with the figure and producer.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The answer says 'there is are particularly extreme outliers'.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Use grammatical plural agreement without changing the conclusion.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The exercise alt text contains repeated agreement errors and reverses the center-peak ordering of the plotted normal, t(df=5), and t(df=1) curves.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Describe the line styles and visible center/tail ordering accurately while leaving the identification task itself unsolved.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The quoted nickname opens with TeX quotes but closes with a straight double quote.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Use a balanced localized quotation; leave authority unchanged.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The summary table declares three columns ('l|r l') but every row contains only two cells, leaving an unintended empty third column.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Use a two-column specification while preserving every statistic and value.

correction_candidates.source_issue: The exercise switches from \star to plain * for the same critical-value notation.
correction_candidates.translation_action: Normalize the learner-visible notation to t^\star and z^\star.
